note: Both sets extract a large number of claims, including many duplicates. Set A is slightly better because Set B invents quote text to describe data points from the graph (e.g., 'Points at conclusion of Energy Balance Contest [y-axis] vs Net Electrical Energy (kWh) [x-axis]; point (-50, 0)'), which violates the rule against inventing quotes. Set A correctly relies on the figure caption or axis labels as they appear.
